# Repository Community Files

This folder contains the documents GitHub uses to support healthy project collaboration.

| File or folder | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | How to propose reproducible code, documentation, and experiment changes |
| `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` | Expectations for respectful, evidence-focused collaboration |
| `SECURITY.md` | Responsible-use boundaries and private vulnerability-reporting guidance |
| `workflows/` | Automated tests and release checks run by GitHub Actions |

The folder intentionally uses `ABOUT.md` instead of `README.md`. GitHub gives `.github/README.md` priority over the project-level README, which would hide the main repository introduction from the home page.
